protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: The neutral registry renderer stopped because the new structured benchmark objects omitted the required artifact_source field. No evidence admission result was reached. The field was added using the already cited committed result JSON.
The Claude Code and Copilot result artifacts use hyphen versus dot forms for Sonnet and Opus model labels. W1 preserves those literals and leaves service-side identity equivalence unresolved.
The Claude Code Sonnet record reports provider openai while the Copilot Sonnet record reports anthropic. W1 does not normalize these fields.
Each harness/model record contains one outcome per each of five tasks; no repeated stochastic trials are published in this snapshot.
Current workflow defaults are not back-projected into the April 2026 runs. Historical per-exercise timeout remains unknown.
